scope: input snapshot ownership/layout copies and Python contour tuple reconstruction; standalone diagnostic, not additive formal timing components

protocol.preparation: capture actual production array_snapshot arguments and C++ sections outputs, restore instrumentation before sampling
protocol.snapshot_timer: all production snapshot calls for the stage plus a retaining tuple; returned arrays released outside the timed interval
protocol.reconstruction_timer: same float conversion, interval tuple creation and row slicing as production _sections; per-frame and paired-frame diagnostics
protocol.limitations: warm cache, standalone allocation lifetimes, no C++ compute in sampled stages; do not add/subtract these values to derive formal costs

input_snapshots.dtype_conversion: none; production snapshot validates dtype and copies for ownership/layout only
